checkpoint.title: Level Paras into Spore Parasect (Lv 27) and Farfetch'd to False Swipe (Lv 46) with Rare Candies

events.why: Evolve Paras into Parasect at Lv 24 and teach Spore at Lv 27 (Gen 3 FireRed learnset).
Level Farfetch'd to Lv 46 so it learns False Swipe (Gen 3 FireRed learnset).
Save the trained Phase 1 catching pair.

metadata.notes: Starts outside Route 4's Pokemon Center with Paras, Farfetch'd, and Rare Candies from frlg.team_training in the bag. Evolves Paras to Parasect with Spore (Lv 27) and levels Farfetch'd to False Swipe (Lv 46). Use frlg.team_training to stock Rare Candies and optionally level both higher (Lv 70-100) before running frlg.dex_collection.
